ownership.shared_factory_contract: IsleActorFactorySpawn.behavior borrows the actual written World-spawn field. Owner admission requires that borrow before the original Meowth factory reads isle_actor_factory_behavior(spawn); no unwritten behavior is fabricated. Behavior1 uses ordinary spawn; all others use ground spawn. Both consume initializer0x802cc968.
ownership.reused_control_provider: Complete original Pokemon movement/control/wait/interaction definitions remain owned by actor-control, and Pokemon_EatApple by Item; none are imported twice.
ownership.lifetime: Aux collision helper captures a native model incarnation before its original waits and reacquires its scale only at the original consumption point. Canonical actor fields remain in ActorOwner; apple clears use shared reference accounting. No independent scene state, clock, Owner, or lifecycle.
ownership.common_relocation_semantics: Full original three-slot loops traverse the native placement translation-slot projection. Native RT/RTS has exactly one AUX translation channel; disabled placement has none and the ground algorithm takes actual ROOT path. Ordinary changes xyz and ground changes xz then independently queries y for model, pos1 and targetPos. Ground query keeps original found?height:0 body, not the movement -9000 fallback. ground=-1 returning wrapper invokes original Meowth behavior dispatcher; 0 ordinary; 1 ground. ground=2 invokes complete original Eevee ground-change-and-remove body: actual current/base signed index compare before playerDist>10000, then real priority4 cleanup scheduling.
required_native_leaves: isle_actor_owner_root_position_store(Source*,captured self-model ref*,position*) publishes true ROOT translation to authoritative Runtime+native; preserves root rotation and scale.
isle_actor_owner_block_indices(Source*,int32_t* current,int32_t* base) consumes actual currentWorld and canonical baseBlock indices with provenance validation.
isle_actor_owner_schedule_cleanup(Source*) invokes real Owner::request_cleanup with original Pokemon_Cleanup synchronous kind1 priority4 process; never drives OM.
